newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa above 900, coffee, sugar below peaks.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa above 900, coffee, sugar below peaks.

text.p: COCOA - Local buying on March and fund short-covering on March lift values. May ends constructively above 900 stg, up 17 at 904 stg.
COFFEE - Ends near peaks but unable to keep pace with surging NY. May/May arbitrage widens to 108 cents. May up $55 at $1,652.
SUGAR - May backs off $310 resistance as NY fails to hold highs. Volume thin. May down $1.50 at $307.50 at 1708 GMT.
